scenarios.title: Bolster puts the counters on the creature with the least toughness, not the least power

setup.notes: Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant. Grizzly Bears is 2/2 and Wall of Wood is 0/3.

decisions: A casts Cached Defenses, tapping all three Forests.
Both players pass; Cached Defenses resolves, and bolster 3 puts its counters on the creature A controls with the least toughness.
Both players pass with the stack empty.

variants.label: bears_lowest
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears (toughness 2) gets three +1/+1 counters and is a 5/5. Wall of Wood (toughness 3, power 0) gets no counters and stays 0/3. Cached Defenses is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: lions_lowest
variants.delta: A controls Savannah Lions (2/1) instead of Wall of Wood.
variants.expected: Savannah Lions (toughness 1) gets three +1/+1 counters and is a 5/4. Grizzly Bears gets no counters and stays 2/2. Cached Defenses is in A's graveyard.

scenarios.title: Bolster only looks at creatures its controller controls

setup.notes: Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant. B's Savannah Lions (2/1) has lower toughness than A's Grizzly Bears (2/2).

decisions: A casts Cached Defenses, tapping all three Forests.
Both players pass; Cached Defenses resolves.
Both players pass with the stack empty.

variants.label: has_creature
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears gets three +1/+1 counters and is a 5/5. Savannah Lions gets no counters and stays 2/1. Cached Defenses is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: no_creature
variants.delta: A controls no creature (Grizzly Bears is not on the battlefield).
variants.expected: Cached Defenses resolves and no counters are put on anything: Savannah Lions stays 2/1 with no counters. Cached Defenses is in A's graveyard.
